description: Preferences update, generated on the write tier: the PUT body once confirmed, the non-empty-object rejection, the response shape, and the preview. The map declares body_root, so its members ARE the body rather than nesting under "preferences". The empty-object case carries confirm because the generated write tier gates before it validates, so an unconfirmed call hears the gate first. A bare-array body is rejected in both languages; a JSON null stays a success, which the free-form payload reads as an empty object.

cases.name: rejects an empty preferences object
cases.expect_error: preferences must be a non-empty object

cases.name: reads a null body as empty preferences
requires confirm
cases.expect_error: This updates profile preferences. Set confirm=true to proceed.
